name: In Nightmares
summary: Falla Sagewind sends a glowing shard to the elder druids in Darnassus. It holds the essence of the Emerald Dream, clouded by dark visions.

sections.title: A Troubling Revelation
sections.body: Falla Sagewind sees more than a crystal in the glowing shard recovered from the depths of Wailing Caverns. Within it lies the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. Yet the shard shows fearful visions where nature should be in harmony. Shaken, Falla will study it no further. She sends you to carry the shard to the senior druids of the Cenarion Circle.

sections.title: Whispers in the Cenarion Enclave
sections.body: Mathrengyl Bearwalker examines the shard you bring to the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. Calm curiosity gives way to unease as he looks into its core. He recognizes that the corruption in the Barrens is tied to disturbances deep within the Emerald Dream. Then Mathrengyl quiets the talk. Such terrors are not for common ears, and he takes the shard into his keeping to study the shadow spreading through the Dream.

faq.answer: The Nightmare Shard is a crystal that holds part of the Emerald Dream's essence. It was first found as a mysterious glowing shard. Its dark visions reveal that a sinister presence has entered the Dream.

Falla Sagewind is a tauren druid who studies nature's lore and examines strange relics found in the wilds. After recognizing the shard's terrifying origin, she sends travelers to the senior druids in Darnassus.

Mathrengyl Bearwalker is an elder druid trainer of the Cenarion Circle at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. He mentors druids and investigates grave spiritual threats to nature and the Emerald Dream.

faq.q: Why is Mathrengyl so secretive about the shard?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl keeps quiet because the shard shows corruption in the Emerald Dream, a sacred realm of nature guided by the Green Dragonflight and sleeping druids. The threat is a profound spiritual crisis, and the Cenarion Circle is reluctant to expose it to the public.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
faq.answer: The story begins with The Glowing Shard, an item found on Mutanus the Devourer at the end of Wailing Caverns. Scholars eventually trace its ominous origin toward Darnassus or Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Do Horde players have an equivalent quest?
aliases: is there a horde in nightmares
faq.answer: Yes. Alliance travelers bring their findings to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus, while Horde travelers report to Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Both hear the same troubling news about the Emerald Dream.

angles.text: As a druid, you learn that the sacred Emerald Dream is not the untouched sanctuary you were taught to commune with. The shard hints at danger within it.
As an Alliance traveler, you carry the relic into Darnassus and give the night elf leadership an early glimpse of corruption spreading beneath the world's surface.
As a night elf, you honor the sleeping realm where Malfurion Stormrage resides. A waking nightmare within its essence strikes at the heart of your spiritual heritage.
